answer: Nonrefundable verification tickets put a cost on every reward attempt. A gale warning, a whisper-level noise reading or a copper assay must carry a paid ticket bound to its job, claimant and epoch. The verifier consumes it once, even when rejecting the work. N accounts making N attempts must purchase N tickets. Set the fee above a junk claim's expected payout. This limits profitable spam only if there are no rebates, free starter tickets or account bonuses.
